identity.name: Navitimer B01 Chronograph 43
identity.one_liner: The 43mm Navitimer B01 Chronograph — the 1952 slide-rule bezel chronograph with the in-house B01 caliber. The most-cited modern Breitling pilot chronograph.

narrative.story: The Navitimer is the 1952 Breitling designed for the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. The slide-rule bezel (the circular scale that allows pilots to do fuel, distance, and time calculations) is the Navitimer's signature. The B01 caliber is the first Breitling in-house chronograph (2009) with a 70-hour reserve. The Navitimer B01 43 is the most-cited modern Breitling pilot chronograph and the watch a collector cites when they want a slide-rule chronograph with a modern manufacture caliber.
narrative.collector_notes: The B01 caliber has a column wheel and a vertical clutch, the modern chronograph standard. The 70-hour reserve is the longest in any modern chronograph.
